purpose: Make graph/interface producer consistency observable as a zero-mismatch gate before later independent module work.
question: Which deterministic same-snapshot facts must be validated after in-memory module interfaces are produced?
decision: TypeChecker validates the module-interface set and order, graph node and identity correspondence, dependency edge order and fields, canonical public vectors, and public-name coverage against ModuleSymbols. The mismatch count is exposed for tests and is not converted into a user-facing diagnostic.

validation_contract.module_set: Every Program module has exactly one interface, interface module IDs are unique and ascending, and graph nodes match the Program module set.
validation_contract.identity: sourceId, display path, canonical path, and entry status match the ModuleStmt and graph node when graph data exists.
validation_contract.dependencies: Interface dependency count, endpoint IDs, edge kinds, requested paths, and graph/source order match.
validation_contract.ordering: Values, structs, enums, and methods are unique and sorted by their canonical public names.
validation_contract.public_names: Interface value, struct, enum, and exported method name sets match ModuleSymbols.

compatibility_boundary.semantics: No type checking, name resolution, lowering, import visibility, or cycle behavior changes.
compatibility_boundary.outputs: Diagnostics, module-interface text, AST, IR, bytecode, cdbc artifacts, runtime output, and Rust VM behavior are unchanged.
compatibility_boundary.persistence: The mismatch count and interface data are snapshot-local and are not serialized or used as persistent cache keys.
compatibility_boundary.producer: ModuleSymbols and dependency-body checking remain the producer path; M3B still owns independent module results and body removal.

migration: Add deterministic post-production validation beside the existing interface producer and consumers, assert zero mismatches on the recursive import/re-export fixture, and retain the validator as an observability gate while future M3A/M3B consumers migrate.
quantitative_gate: The focused ir_source_location, module_interface_emitter, and golden checks pass with moduleInterfaceMismatchCount equal to zero; verification_inventory validates 1,745 cases; and full legacy, canonical, boundary, malformed, artifact, and Rust VM commands report zero unexplained differences.
old_path_deletion_condition: Delete no production path here. Remove a validation branch only together with the compatibility path it protects after a later reviewed M3A/M3B decision and proof.
affected_consumers: module graph identity and dependency consumers
out_of_scope: serialized interface validation and version negotiation
independent module checking and dependency-body deletion
per-module cdbc artifacts and linker/load rules

focused_commands: python3 tests/run_golden_tests.py ./build/compiler_design --case module_interface --case generic_imports --case generic_method_imports --case generic_struct_method_imports
